title.en: Sam Altman fired and rehired in four days — the defining corporate governance crisis of the AI era
title.zhHans: Sam Altman 四天内被解职又重新聘用——AI 时代最具代表性的公司治理危机

searchSummary.en: Sam Altman fired and rehired in 4 days (November 2023) — the defining corporate drama of the AI era. How a boardroom battle nearly collapsed OpenAI and changed AI governance.
searchSummary.zhHans: Sam Altman 在 4 天内被解雇又复职（2023 年 11 月）——AI 时代最具标志性的公司戏剧。一场董事会斗争如何差点让 OpenAI 崩溃，并改变了 AI 治理格局。

summary.en: On November 17, 2023, OpenAI's board fired CEO Sam Altman, citing lack of candor. What followed was four days of chaos: nearly all 770 employees threatened to quit, the board appointed and replaced two interim CEOs, Microsoft hired Altman then scrapped the deal, and by November 21, Altman was reinstated with a new board. The crisis revealed fundamental governance problems at the world's most important AI company — a structure designed for safety had almost destroyed the company.
summary.zhHans: 2023 年 11 月 17 日，OpenAI 董事会解雇了 CEO Sam Altman，理由是不坦诚。随后的四天陷入混乱：几乎所有 770 名员工威胁辞职，董事会任命并更换了两任临时 CEO，微软聘用了 Altman 后又废止了协议，到 11 月 21 日 Altman 复职并拥有新董事会。这场危机揭示了全球最重要 AI 公司的基础治理问题——一个为安全设计的结构几乎摧毁了公司。

narrative.en: The OpenAI board's decision to fire Sam Altman on November 17, 2023, set off the most dramatic corporate crisis in Silicon Valley history. The board's statement that Altman 'was not consistently candid in his communications' was deliberately vague, sparking intense speculation about the reasons: safety concerns about rapid deployment, personal conflicts between Altman and board members (including chief scientist Ilya Sutskever), or disagreements about OpenAI's transition from non-profit to for-profit. The crisis unfolded in stages. Day 1: Altman fired, CTO Mira Murati appointed interim CEO, president Greg Brockman quit in protest. Day 2: Reports of investor pressure on the board to reverse course; former Twitch CEO Emmett Shear appointed as new interim CEO. Day 3: Nearly all 770 OpenAI employees signed a letter demanding the board resign and Altman be reinstated, threatening to join Microsoft. Ilya Sutskever, who had voted to fire Altman, publicly regretted his decision and joined the employee letter. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella announced Altman and Brockman would lead a new AI research team at Microsoft. Day 4: The board capitulated. Altman returned as CEO, a new initial board was formed (including Bret Taylor, Larry Summers, and Adam D'Angelo), and the crisis that had threatened to destroy OpenAI ended. The incident had lasting consequences. It exposed the tension between OpenAI's non-profit governance structure and its for-profit operations — a tension that eventually led to the October 2025 PBC restructuring. It established that employees had more power than the board at critical AI companies. And it elevated Sam Altman from CEO to something approaching an irreplaceable figure for OpenAI — a dynamic that shaped subsequent governance decisions.
narrative.zhHans: OpenAI 董事会于 2023 年 11 月 17 日决定解雇 Sam Altman，引发了硅谷历史上最戏剧性的公司危机。董事会关于 Altman"在沟通中未能始终坦诚"的说法有意模糊，引发了激烈的猜测：关于快速部署的安全担忧、Altman 与董事会成员（包括首席科学家 Ilya Sutskever）之间的个人冲突，或关于 OpenAI 从非营利向营利转型的分歧。危机分阶段展开。第一天：Altman 被解雇，CTO Mira Murati 被任命为临时 CEO，总裁 Greg Brockman 辞职抗议。第二天：投资者向董事会施压要求改变方向的报道出现；前 Twitch CEO Emmett Shear 被任命为新临时 CEO。第三天：几乎所有 770 名 OpenAI 员工签署联名信要求董事会辞职、Altman 复职，并威胁加入微软。投票解雇 Altman 的 Ilya Sutskever 公开后悔并加入了员工联名信。微软 CEO Satya Nadella 宣布 Altman 和 Brockman 将领导微软新 AI 研究团队。第四天：董事会妥协。Altman 以 CEO 身份回归，组建了新董事会（包括 Bret Taylor、Larry Summers 和 Adam D'Angelo），这场威胁摧毁 OpenAI 的危机结束了。该事件产生了持久影响。它暴露了 OpenAI 的非营利治理结构与营利运营之间的张力——这种张力最终导致了 2025 年 10 月的 PBC 重组。它证明了在关键 AI 公司，员工比董事会拥有更多权力。它将 Sam Altman 从 CEO 提升为 OpenAI 不可替代的人物——这种动态塑造了随后的治理决策。

description.en: Revealed fundamental governance problems at the world's most important AI company. Exposed tension between non-profit safety mission and for-profit operations. Led to eventual PBC restructuring in 2025. Demonstrated employee power > board power at critical AI companies.
description.zhHans: 揭示了全球最重要 AI 公司的根本治理问题。暴露了非营利安全使命与营利运营之间的张力。最终导致了 2025 年 PBC 重组。证明了关键 AI 公司中员工权力大于董事会权力。

text.en: OpenAI fired Sam Altman on November 17, 2023. After 4 days of employee revolt and board crisis, Altman was reinstated as CEO on November 21, 2023.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2023 年 11 月 17 日解雇了 Sam Altman。经过 4 天的员工反抗和董事会危机，Altman 于 2023 年 11 月 21 日复职为 CEO。

text.en: Some governance experts argued that the board's ability to fire the CEO was functioning exactly as OpenAI's non-profit structure intended — as a safety check — and that the employee revolt undermined the very purpose of the governance design.
text.zhHans: 一些治理专家认为董事会解雇 CEO 的能力恰好按 OpenAI 非营利结构的意图运行——作为安全检查——而员工反抗恰恰削弱了治理设计的初衷。
